body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Sony(www.sony.com) introduced 'VAIO F Serise Laptop 3D Multimedia PC' at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.
